probes.check: am_probe_acme_allocation(): Scheduler::allocator() is the facade's acme-jobs allocator, and the facade's acme-jobs counter rises when the scheduler starts.

seeded_violation.description: Leave SchedulerDesc::allocator null so acme-jobs uses its default heap.

not_applicable.reason: acme-jobs takes its allocator per instance, at construction; it cannot allocate before the hook exists.

adaptation_notes: The facade's allocator object outlives the scheduler; destroy the scheduler in the jobs phase before the memory phase ends.
